title: The Basis on Which the Money Going Back to a Healthy Options Card Is Struck
content:
Whether a recovery onto a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card is net of what the member bore, nil, or the whole of what the card was charged, turns on the card's own tier and on whether the card was actually used at a dental, vision or hearing provider.

**The rule.** The money going back is what the card was charged at those providers less what the member was left to bear, where the card is one on which dental, vision and hearing costs may be met and the card has been used at such a provider; it is nothing at all, where the card is one on which such costs may be met and the card has not been used at such a provider in the stretch looked at; and it is the whole of what the card was charged at those providers in every other case, the cost never having been one the card could meet.

**Reading the two conditions.** Whether dental, vision and hearing costs may be met from the card is a term of the card's tier. Whether the card has been used at such a provider is read from the card's own entries in the stretch looked at, counting the transactions there that settled.

**A truth table.**

| Dental, vision and hearing costs may be met from this card | The card was used at such a provider in the stretch | The money going back |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes, a settled transaction stands | what the card was charged at those providers, less what the member was left to bear |
| yes | no settled transaction stands | nothing at all |
| no | yes | the whole of what the card was charged at those providers |
| no | no | the whole of what the card was charged at those providers |

The reason the last two rows differ from the first is stated in the rule itself: on a card that cannot meet such a cost, the cost was never one the card could meet, so nothing the member bore is set against it.

**Worked through on hypothetical figures.** On a card that may meet such costs and that shows a settled purchase at an optician, with 229.55 USD charged at those providers and 70.00 USD borne by the member, the money going back is 159.55 USD. On the same card with no settled purchase at any such provider in the stretch, it is nothing. On a card that may not meet such costs, with 229.55 USD charged at those providers, it is the whole 229.55 USD.
